def layout(fr):
    d = {}
    for n in fr.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['pixels'] <= 16:
            rows=[p[0] for p in n['boundary']]; cols=[p[1] for p in n['boundary']]

    return d
before = layout(current_frame)

print("changed:")
for k in sorted(set(before)|set(after)):
    if before.get(k)!=after.get(k): print(k, before.get(k), '->', after.get(k))
print("level_completed:", res.get('level_completed'))

def layout(fr):
    d = {}
    for n in fr.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['pixels'] <= 16:
            rows=[p[0] for p in n['boundary']]; cols=[p[1] for p in n['boundary']]
            d[(min(rows),min(cols))] = n['color']
    return d
before = layout(current_frame)
res = action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':25,'col':15}])
after = layout(current_frame)
print("changed:")
for k in sorted(set(before)|set(after)):
    if before.get(k)!=after.get(k): print(k, before.get(k), '->', after.get(k))
print("level_completed:", res.get('level_completed'))
</parameter>
</function>
